messages:
marta_cs: Heads up — VioletIQ onboarding hitting consistent P95 ~220ms but we saw tail spikes up to ~1.2s around 11:30 PST for short prompt traffic. Usage is lots of short, chatty calls. Thinking: run a small canary to route 50% to compact-2b (int8 quant) + enable prefix KV caching, measure latency/cost/quality. Any concerns?

ops_bot: alert: customer: VioletIQ, metric: generate.latency_tail, window: 11:20-11:40, p99=1.18s, p95=0.22s, error_rate=0.0%

divyesh_re: +1 to trying int8 compact for this workload. Quick note — ensure sampling params (top_k/top_p/temperature) are preserved when switching model aliases. Also watch for tokenization deltas (may affect length/claims).

sam_engineering: I can spin up a dev-dedicated canary pool and route traffic for a few hours. Proposed plan: 2-hr canary, 50/50 split, collect prefix cache hit rate, latency histograms, and perf vs. the eval prompt set.

eli_se: Customer told me they're fine with tiny quality diffs if latency/cost improve. They asked for a rough cost delta estimate — ballpark 30-40% token-cost reduction for int8 on compact-2b vs standard-7b for their profile. :chart_with_downwards_trend:

marta_cs: Perfect. Let's be explicit about rollback criteria: if top-level quality metric (pairwise eval set) drops >1.0% or p99 worsens, rollback immediately. Also capture a small sample of golden prompts for manual review.

divyesh_re: Canary pool ready on dev-dedicated-5. Started routing at 09:05 PST. Initial numbers after 20m: median latency -18%, p95 -26%, cache hit ~42%. No runtime exceptions. Dashboard: https://dash.redwood/v/violetiq/canary123

sam_engineering: Config deployed (snippet):
```json
{
  "customer": "violetiq",
  "route_policy": "split",
  "variants": [
    {"model": "compact-2b-int8", "weight": 50},
    {"model": "standard-7b", "weight": 50}
  ],
  "cache": {"prefix_kv": true, "ttl_sec": 900}
}
```

eli_se: I'll prep a 25-sample golden set and run quick quality diffs. Sharing results in ~45m.

vivian_csm: I'll message the customer with the canary plan and expected rollback criteria. Scheduling full rollout for 9am PST tomorrow if canary passes. @marta_cs I'll capture their feedback in the enablement notes. :white_check_mark:

marta_cs: Thanks team. After canary completes let's export the eval run (automated) + manual notes. If everything looks good we'll request cost estimate for a permanent routing policy and suggest enabling caching on their production route.

divyesh_re: Canary completed at 11:05 PST. Automated eval: relative quality delta = -0.3% (within threshold). Cost sim: ~36% savings estimated. Marking canary as PASS.

marta_cs: Awesome — I'll log this in the onboarding tracker and notify renewal owner that we have an ops playbook to reduce unit cost while improving latency. Closing out here and will post a short enablement deck to the customer. :rocket:
